question: What kind of certificates are provided?
answer: Certificates depend on the plan you choose. The ₹7,999 (6-Month Internship) plan includes: 1) Internship Completion Certificate, 2) Training Certificate, and 3) Letter of Recommendation (LOR). The ₹999 plan includes: 1) Internship Completion Certificate and 2) Letter of Recommendation (LOR). All credentials are issued under the WeIntern brand and can be added to your LinkedIn profile.

question: Will I get a certificate after completing the internship?
answer: Yes. All WeIntern programs include certificates upon successful completion. The ₹7,999 (6-Month) plan provides an Internship Completion Certificate, a Training Certificate, and an LOR. The ₹999 plan provides an Internship Completion Certificate and an LOR. You must complete all course modules and real client projects to be eligible.

question: How can I verify my certificate?
answer: Certificate verification is done through the official WeIntern process. Contact support at +91 74149 74582 (WhatsApp) or contact.weintern@gmail.com for the certificate verification link or process after completion.

question: Can I add the certificate to LinkedIn?
answer: Yes. You can add the WeIntern verified certificate to your LinkedIn profile to showcase your internship and project experience to recruiters.

question: What are the criteria to get the certificate?
answer: To receive your WeIntern certificate you must: 1) Complete all required course modules. 2) Submit and complete the real client projects. 3) Meet the program's attendance and participation requirements.

question: How long does it take to receive the certificate?
answer: Certificate issuance timelines depend on the program completion and verification process. Contact support at contact.weintern@gmail.com or +91 74149 74582 for the current certificate delivery timeline.

question: Certificate kab milta hai?
answer: Certificate program ke hisaab se milta hai. ₹7,999 (6-Month) plan mein Internship Completion Certificate, Training Certificate aur Letter of Recommendation (LOR) teeno milte hain. ₹999 plan mein Internship Completion Certificate aur LOR milte hain. Yeh internship successfully complete karne aur real client projects submit karne ke baad issue kiye jaate hain. Delivery timeline ke liye contact.weintern@gmail.com par email karein ya +91 74149 74582 par WhatsApp karein.

question: Kya certificate LinkedIn par add kar sakte hain?
answer: Haan. WeIntern verified certificate LinkedIn profile par add kiya ja sakta hai recruiters ko apna internship experience dikhane ke liye.
